entities.summary: Ramchandra Vidyabagish was an Indian lexicographer and Sanskrit scholar. His Bangabhashabhidhan, the first monolingual Bengali dictionary, was published in 1817. He taught at the Vedanta College established by Raja Rammohun Roy, and later at Sanskrit College from 1827 to 1837. Closely associated with the work of Rammohun Roy in Kolkata, he was the first secretary of the Brahmo Sabha, established in 1828, and initiated Debendranath Tagore and 21 other young men into Brahmo Samaj in 1843. Ram Chandra Vidyabagish was a writers & intellectuals (1786–1845-03-02). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Ram Chandra Vidyabagish's Bangabhashabhidhan was a foundational work in Bengali language and literature, contributing to the development of modern Bengali. His association with Raja Rammohun Roy and the Brahmo Sabha helped spread Sanskrit education and promote social reform.
